However, I want to highlight your consistent improvement in the previous weeks, particularly the week of May 15-21, where you billed 36.5 hours. Let's channel that momentum into this next week!

- Your overall pacing of 21.0 hours last week is below the expected level. This indicates a need to increase your engagement with available tasks. Focusing on the jobs in the queue can help boost your productivity. Consider setting a daily goal for hours billed to keep yourself accountable.

## Action Items for This Week
1. Pick up at least one job from the shared queue this week, ideally starting with RO 777785, to get back on track with your hours.
2. Set a daily goal of at least 5 hours billed each day to gradually build up your performance metrics.
3. Review any pending parts or issues on previous jobs to ensure that you are ready to tackle them as soon as they are available.
